summary: SynergySuite, in the restaurant back-office software market since 2011 and led by CEO Jared Neilsen, provides cloud-based, mobile-first enterprise back-office software (inventory, purchasing, recipe costing, food safety, scheduling, cash management, HR, business intelligence) used by chains including Tropical Smoothie Cafe, Pollo Campero, Costa Vida, KFC, Macaroni Grill, and BrewDog, with customers reportedly saving an average of 2-8% on food and labor costs.

SynergySuite closed a $12 million funding round in August 2025, led by Oyster Capital with support from First Analysis and Lago Innovation, to accelerate an AI engine for restaurant chain operations and support global expansion.
